5 تبدّع He turned innovator. (O, K.) Ru-beh says, “أِنْ كُنْتَ لِلٰهِ التَّقِىَّ الأَطْوَعَا
فَلَيْسَ وَجْهَ الحَقِّ أَنْ تَبَدَّعَا
” [If thou be, towards God, the pious, the very obedient, it is not the right way that thou shouldst turn innovator]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
